b2.ceria_and_olesm_found_in_the_coffins.news: Two survivors of the Ruins came out after days in the dark: the half-Elf mage Ceria Springwalker and the Watch's own [Tactician], Olesm.

canon_ref.note: Three or four days in the coffins; Ceria made ice to drink. Calruz is not found: Ceria saw Skinner tear off his arm and believes everyone else died (2.04). He stays missing.

b2.ceria_and_olesm_found_in_the_coffins.summary: In the tomb hall Ryoka guesses the survivors hid in the coffins. Ceria lies in one, starved, her right hand dead bone after she burned out her wand to open a gap; Olesm, who dragged her in and saved her, is in another. Ceria says everyone else is gone.

system.name: [Bar Fighting]
system.note: Works only with things found in a bar or kitchen, so she fights with frying pans.
